in_marathi.name: Mohak
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Delight, Charm, Enchant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mohak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From the Sanskrit word 'mohana' meaning 'to delight' or 'to enchant'. In Hindu mythology, Mohak refers to the power of charm or enchantment. It is also the name of a god in the Hindu pantheon, Mohakalishtha, who is believed to possess the power of attraction.
